recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the applied FHIR-32533 source correction; SD can separately close or relate the later unresolved ballot comments if this reconciliation satisfies their concern.
issue_request: FHIR-32533 requested that Composition.type, Composition.date, Composition.author, and Composition.title not be mandatory for all Composition use cases. The Applied/Persuasive with Modification resolution loosened author and title to optional but retained type and date as required.
initial_application: Commit 160c286be6540041b2468bd7b618fc7c4e907297 changed Composition.author from 1..* to 0..* and Composition.title from 1..1 to 0..1 in source/composition/structuredefinition-Composition.xml, but left the Composition.title comment and Composition notes page saying title was mandatory.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini has an active composition=Composition resource entry, so source/composition/structuredefinition-Composition.xml and source/composition/composition-notes.xml are current build inputs. FHIR-7073 is the earlier Published decision that introduced mandatory-title feedback for document-profile use cases. Later FHIR-54115 and FHIR-54510 identify the same stale mandatory-title comment but remain unresolved and were not decided here. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence beyond SD agenda/minutes mentions consistent with the Jira handling.
reconciliation: Changed the Composition.title ElementDefinition comment to state that profiles can require title when needed while base Composition leaves it optional for organizer use cases, and removed the obsolete Composition notes bullet that said title was mandatory during the trial-use period. No change was made to type/date cardinalities because the final Jira resolution retained them as required.
